s1.syndrome_frame: A slowly enlarging, firm, painless mass in the left labia majora with a history of recurrences
salient_findings: A slowly enlarging mass in the left labia majora over 10 years
The mass was firm, painless, immobile, and measured approximately 7 × 4 cm
key_facts: The patient is a 64-year-old woman
The mass has been slowly enlarging over 10 years
The mass is firm, painless, and immobile
The mass measures approximately 7 × 4 cm
The patient has a history of excisions of masses in the Bartholin’s gland and labia majora
Histopathology has shown chondroid syringoma and clear cell hidradenoma
Ultrasound revealed a heterogeneous, hypervascular subcutaneous mass
CT scan demonstrated a heterogeneous, contrast-enhancing lesion in the left labia majora
A low-density focus in the liver was suggestive of a simple cyst
The patient has experienced recurrences near the fourchette

rejected.label: Clear cell hidradenoma
rejected.why: Although the patient has a history of clear cell hidradenoma, the most recent histopathology results confirm chondroid syringoma.

rejected.label: Vulvar adenocarcinoma
rejected.why: There is no mention of malignant features or adenocarcinoma in the histopathology results.

rejected.label: Bartholin gland carcinoma
rejected.why: The patient's history of excisions in the Bartholin's gland does not indicate carcinoma, and the current mass is in the labia majora.

rejected.label: Aggressive angiomyxoma
rejected.why: The mass's characteristics, such as being firm and well-circumscribed, do not suggest aggressive angiomyxoma, which is typically soft and infiltrative.
